name: The Briar Blade
body:
Aura strong conjuration, necromancy, transmutation; CL 20th; Slot none; Weight 6 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This bastard sword appears to have been grown rather than forged, and the flanges of its elaborate hilt and elegant blade are set with strange stones glistening in shades deeper than emerald and blooming with growths of finest silver.

Briar blade is an intelligent +5 cold iron vorpal bastard sword whose special purpose is to defeat denizens of the land of the fey.

STATISTICS

Alignment CN; Ego 23; Senses 120 ft., darkvision
Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 16
Communication empathy, speech, telepathy
Languages Aklo, Common, Sylvan

Powers

3/day—barkskin (wielder only), blight (as swift action upon a creature it strikes in combat)
1/month—true resurrection (wielder only)
